rationale: This is a failed gap-up that has already fully retraced — price sits below the prior close and 16% off the high on ~74% float turnover — meaning the freshest part of the short side has already been paid out. The last five candles show rising lows, a reclaim of the 9-EMA, and sharply drying volume, which undercuts a fresh short, while a long would be countertrend into trapped supply near the 5-min VWAP ($23.71) and prior close. With 5m ATR ($0.05) equal to the spread, transaction friction alone consumes most of the next likely move, so neither direction offers a favorable risk/reward in the final hour.
